phases.name: updateAttackAndDefendAmounts
phases.description: Smooth attack and defend flags into the persistent appearance state.

phases.name: blendBodyColors
phases.description: Blend default, action and flash colors, retaining guarded unsigned conversion.

phases.name: setBodyFill
phases.description: Select rounded line caps, body line width, fill color and optional grayscale.

phases.name: setBodyStroke
phases.description: Compute the shaded outline and optional grayscale color.

phases.name: drawBody
phases.description: Draw the alternate model path or circular body, then fill and stroke it.

phases.name: drawFlagFourDecoration
phases.description: Draw the decoration selected by appearance flag mask 4 and restore the drawing state.

phases.name: prepareEyeContext
phases.description: Store original pointers used by the eye renderer.

phases.name: saveFaceDrawingState
phases.description: Save the canvas and the 64-byte software drawing state.

phases.name: updateEyeExpression
phases.description: Smooth the first expression flag unless attack, defend, death or the extra action flag suppresses it.

phases.name: drawEyes
phases.description: Draw the polygonal expression or place each eye through the original eye renderer.

phases.name: restoreFaceDrawingState
phases.description: Restore the face drawing state and canvas.

phases.name: translateMouth
phases.description: Translate the mouth origin by ten units, retaining all expanded f32 affine products.

phases.name: drawAlternateModelMouth
phases.description: Draw the mouth geometry selected by appearance model one.

phases.name: updateMouthCurve
phases.description: Smooth the persistent mouth curve from the expression and death flags.

phases.name: drawMouth
phases.description: Draw the mouth quadratic curve with grayscale outline and exact transform synchronization.

validation.registration: Candidate source body; parent task owns registry/build integration.

limitations: The complete original body1100 is recovered; powF64 (375), drawEye (690), the Canvas host and other named callees remain explicit dependencies. This report does not claim their transitive recovery.
Flag mask 4 and model 1 are described by their observed drawing branches without assigning unconfirmed product or cosmetic names.
Finite fixtures compare all shared memory, decoded Canvas calls, traps and stack state. They do not prove every arbitrary alias or browser pixel output.
Registered by the parent task after review and original-WASM differential tests; current build/browser identity is in reports/current-verification.json.
dependencyClosureDefinition: Every statically reachable internal WASM body through direct calls is recovered; external host callback reentry is outside this graph, and any indirect-call site conservatively makes the result false.
